candidates.rationale: Commerce platform for online stores with payments and multichannel tools; clearly similar merchant software to Shopify.

candidates.name: incir.com
candidates.description: incir.com fits because it lets users "create their own fully operational e-commerce website" and handles "order management; payment processing, procurement, packaging, shipping and delivering" on behalf of shop owners.
candidates.rationale: Likely an e-commerce service/outsourcing provider for shop owners, not a same-category commerce platform like Shopify.

candidates.name: Kauplus
candidates.description: Kauplus matches because it is a "full-featured e-commerce platform" for creating an online store with "payment by credit card", "automatic order and inventory management", and store control features.
candidates.rationale: E-commerce platform with store, payments, and inventory management; same merchant software category as Shopify.

candidates.name: Plugo
candidates.description: Plugo fits because it is an "all-in-one e-commerce platform" that provides custom online stores with "payment and courier integrations" and "omnichannel" features.
candidates.rationale: E-commerce platform for merchants with stores, payments, and omnichannel operations; same category and buyer persona as Shopify.

candidates.name: Dopigo
candidates.description: Dopigo matches because it is a cloud solution to manage "e-ticaret operasyonlarınızı tek bir noktadan" with integrations for marketplaces and Shopify, plus tools for "stoklarınızı, siparişlerinizi" and invoicing.
candidates.rationale: Partner/integration tool for Shopify merchants, not a peer commerce platform competing with Shopify.

candidates.name: Eqomos Pvt Ltd
candidates.description: Eqomos fits because it is a cutting-edge eCommerce platform with "Omnichannel Integration", "Multiple Payment Options", "Automated Invoicing", "Logistics Management", and "Customer 360" for online commerce operations.
candidates.rationale: Eqomos appears to be an eCommerce commerce platform with payments, logistics, and omnichannel features, making it a Shopify-like lookalike.

candidates.name: Voracio Commerce
candidates.description: Voracio Commerce matches because it is a "cloud eCommerce platform" for retailers with "Order Processing", "Inventory Management", "Systems Integration", and "Multichannel Retail" capabilities.
candidates.rationale: Cloud commerce platform for retailers with similar store, inventory, payments, and multichannel retail capabilities.

candidates.name: RapidCart
candidates.description: RapidCart fits because it is an "E-commerce Platform for Single-Vendor & Multi-Vendor Businesses" that provides storefronts, mobile apps, and "product, order, delivery & inventory management" in one system.
candidates.rationale: E-commerce platform for merchants with storefronts, apps, payments, and operations management; closely matches Shopify’s merchant-facing commerce software model.

candidates.name: Linx Commerce
candidates.description: Linx Commerce matches because it is "A Plataforma de E-commerce que move o Varejo" and offers a suite for retail with B2C, B2B, marketplace, and omnichannel commerce capabilities.
candidates.rationale: E-commerce commerce platform for merchants, similar retail/omnichannel software targeting comparable buyers.

candidates.name: 6th Street Inc.
candidates.description: 6th Street Commerce fits because it provides an "end-to-end E-commerce platform" for retailers with a platform integrating the online store with "warehouse management, inventory, ordering, storefront and CRM systems".
candidates.rationale: End-to-end ecommerce platform for retailers; same merchant-facing commerce software category as Shopify.

candidates.name: zVendo.com
candidates.description: zVendo matches because it is an "e-Commerce SaaS platform for merchants to build" online stores with "payment gateways", "shipping services" integrations, and a unified dashboard for sales channels.
candidates.rationale: Same type of commerce platform for merchants, with store building, payments, shipping integrations, and multichannel sales management.

candidates.name: StoreWings
candidates.description: StoreWings fits because it is an "e-commerce suite" that helps users create and manage their own branded online stores with tools for "product management, payments, and shipping".
candidates.rationale: E-commerce platform for merchants with store creation, payments, and shipping—same buyer and product category as Shopify.
